text: ことしこそ　およげる　ように　なるんだ！

structure.jp: およげる　ように　なるんだ！
structure.en: I'm going to become able to swim!

patterns.name: 〜ようになる
patterns.span: およげる　ように　なる
patterns.explanation: ようになる after a verb says a change happens: you reach the point where you do or can do it. およげる　ように　なる = 'become able to swim'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb's ending to える turns 'do' into 'can do'. およぐ 'swim' becomes およげる = 'can swim'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end adds feeling, here firm determination. なるんだ = 'I'm going to become it, I mean it'.
